heard: They brought the ark of God inside the tent. David had pitched it for the covenant. Before God they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings for the nation. When the work was done, he blessed the people. In the name of the Lord Most High To every man and woman in Israel He gave bread, meat, and raisin cake Give thanks to the Lord, call on His name Make known among the nations what He has done Sing to Him, sing praise to Him
